requirement: Settings › Help & about has a Getting started row that always reopens the screen: ring + progress line, All set when done, a note when hidden from the account menu, Open

oracle.invariant: In progress (web, no AI account): .ts-help-row[data-help-item='getting-started'] with title 'Getting started', a decorative (aria-hidden) ring whose arc offset is C·(1−2/3), the line '2 of 3 setup steps complete.' and a button 'Open' wearing the class the section hands over. Every step done: the ring shows a tick instead of the arc and the line reads 'All set. Open it again any time.'; the row stays. Hidden from the account menu: the line ends with '· Hidden from the account menu' (the dot aria-hidden); the row stays. Open opens the screen in reopened mode; Show in account menu there clears the note underneath without a reload. Operator switch 'onboarding' off: no row. Through apply(): registered into settings.help.item with id tracy-onboard.getting-started, order 10, locale tracy-onboard. Help & about renders settings.help.item once, after the update row and its switches and before the release notes (web: after the web line, before the links), handing over buttonClassName equal to the class of its own 'Check for updates' button.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
